Title/subtitle/keyword set against real demand ('screen time', 'journal', 'data export', 'digital wellbeing', 'quantified self'); worth thousands of free installs/month at no marginal cost. Build the keyword set + 3 subtitle variants NOW, ship with 1.0. (b) **POST-EXPORT INTENT, which nobody owns** — everyone chases 'how do I export my X data'; the higher-intent query is the one that comes AFTER the email arrives: 'what do I do with my ChatGPT export', 'how to open conversations.json', 'how to read my Instagram data download'. That person has the file in hand THIS MINUTE. One page per query, each ending at the demo. (c) **THE DELETION MOMENT** — 'take your record before you delete your account' attaches us to a mass behaviour with existing search volume (delete Instagram/Facebook/X) that REQUIRES an export first. We own the prerequisite of a thing millions already do. (d) **DECEMBER COUNTER-PROGRAMMING** — Wrapped season is the one month a year the whole internet posts artefacts about their own record. 'Wrapped for everything else', run in the browser, no install, any export. Our Sept/Oct launch lands perfectly to be ready; the First Reading (#34) IS the artefact. Prepare in November, fire in December. (e) **THE WAITING ROOM** — the funnel's hole is the hours-to-days between requesting an export and receiving it. A page that holds that window: what Sentr will look for in this exact file, a sample reading, and a downloadable .ics reminder for when the archive lands. Fixes abandonment instead of buying more traffic. (f) **ALLY DISTRIBUTION, evergreen and free** — privacy tool directories (privacytools-style lists, awesome-privacy, local-first software indexes) + an EMBEDDABLE demo widget other privacy/QS blogs can drop into a post. Their audiences, our tool, zero spend. KILLED AGAIN in this pass: paid acquisition (LTV-negative until D30>=15%), influencer budget (same arithmetic, worse tracking), referral programs (a vault that asks you to spam contacts poisons its one asset), and any B2B2C therapy/coaching angle for now (health-adjacent claims are a canon and App Review risk we will not take pre-launch). ORDER: (b)+(e) are pure writing and start immediately in the cloud lane; (a) ships with 1.0; (c) is one page + guide cross-links; (f) is a list of 20 submissions for the founder; (d) is prepared in November.

Ten mechanics with a track record elsewhere, each canon-safe, each with its kill number: (1) **RESURFACING THE PERSON'S OWN PAST** (Timehop/On This Day/Google Memories — the most proven re-engagement mechanic in consumer software; we already hold the raw material) kill: <20% return on resurfacing days; (2) STANDING APPOINTMENT — dated wager resolutions, kill: <30% return on resolution day; (3) PERIODIC RECKONING — the Reading revised monthly inside the six-interruptions law (Wrapped/Strava weekly/Fitness weekly are the tested pattern, and it is the canon-safe substitute for streaks), kill: <35% open; (4) ACCUMULATION AS SWITCHING COST — the shelf of dated Readings, made visible early, kill: churn does not fall with cohort record-age; (5) ANNUAL AS RITUAL not discount — the sealed envelope opened next August, kill: annual attach <15% by M3; (6) **FIRST VALUE UNDER 60 SECONDS** (time-to-first-value is the strongest known D30 predictor across consumer software) = board #32, kill: TTFF >60s or D1 <40%; (7) PAYWALL AFTER VALUE — our earned-ask law is already the tested-best placement; resist moving it earlier, kill: <2% at the ask; (8) PAUSE INSTEAD OF CANCEL — 'keep my record, stop the appointments', kill: <15% of cancellations choose pause; (9) CONCIERGE ONBOARDING for the first 500 — founder personally lands their first finding; also how we learn whether card one surprises anyone, kill: touched cohort retains no better at D30; (10) WIN-BACK WITH A COMPUTED ARTEFACT not a discount (discounts train people to leave and return cheaper), kill: <5% reactivation. board.task: **THE KILL CRITERION FIRED — testers said BORING, USELESS, NOT FULLY FUNCTIONING, EMPTY. THIS OUTRANKS EVERY OTHER ITEM ON THIS BOARD INCLUDING #31.** Full diagnosis and rebuild: night_shift/THE_BORING_FIX.md. Four words = four separate failures, and only two are dangerous: 'NOT FUNCTIONING' + 'EMPTY' are engineering, already assigned (#32 TTFF, #30 connections, archive door) — days of work, least important thing they said. 'BORING' is the product: **A COUNT IS NOT A FINDING.** We read the no-verdicts law as 'only report counts', and a bare frequency about yourself is interesting for four seconds. Nobody is surprised by a number about themselves; they are surprised by a CONTRADICTION. The canon forbids interpretation — it does NOT forbid CONTRAST. 'USELESS' means nothing changes because they read it — no job done. **THE REBUILD — THE CONTRADICTION ENGINE. The unit of value changes from `finding` to `gap`.** A gap has four evidenced, uninterpreted parts: the CLAIM (something they actually said/wrote/scheduled, quoted and dated from their own record), the RECORD (what the counting shows happened instead), the DISTANCE (stated numerically), the RECEIPTS (dated rows behind both sides, tappable). Example, canon-legal and not boring: 'You said you would call your mother every week. You called nine times in six months.' Two counts side by side; no verdict; nothing interpreted. GAP FAMILIES IN BUILD ORDER: (1) SAID vs DID from reminders + calendar ALONE — highest hit rate, needs NO export, therefore it fixes 'empty' in the same stroke; (2) THEN vs NOW (a year ago's words against today's); (3) WORDS vs HOURS; (4) DECLARED vs REPEATED. Register law unchanged: state both counts and STOP — never why, never advice; care floor still outranks everything and holds any gap touching grief, health or harm. WHY IT ALSO FIXES 'USELESS': a gap implies a next move without prescribing one, and it creates the missing loop — the person can now make a claim ON PURPOSE and be graded on a date (the wager book). It is also the first thing anyone would post: a gap shares itself, where trivia never did. RE-TEST: the SAME ten people, same protocol, same silence, same single question. They have seen the boring version, which makes them the harshest possible audience and the only 'oh' worth anything. COST, stated honestly: 2-4 weeks and the aggressive September band. CORRECT TRADE — launching the boring version gets the same four words from strangers at a price we cannot recover (one-shot moments spent, first impressions burned).
